name: mix_resolver
note: The Mix resolver (target picker, facing and menu rebuilds hooked, as in FFX-G05): record = slot count and the flat list of 16-bit fields (two per slot); mask = what the scripted target picker returned. Real machine code; the note's model agrees on every vector.
tableNote: table[a][b] = the u16 the real resolver wrote for ingredients with item indices a and b (every ordered pair of the 112 items).
